label: Business Interest
_comment: STARTER RULE SET -- built from publicly available material only (Vetting APP, Code of Ethics, Working Time Regulations 1998, fragments of the Counter Corruption APP and public IOPC reporting). This is a draft starting point, not the definitive national standard. Replace or extend the fields below with your own CCU-informed grading criteria -- no code changes needed. Edited by hand or via the app's rules editor; loaded fresh on every request.

fields.label: Nature of the business/activity
fields.why_it_matters: What the business actually does is the starting point for judging any conflict with policing duties.

fields.label: Hours per week involved, and cumulative hours combined with police role
fields.why_it_matters: Working Time Regulations 1998 relevance (48-hour week) cannot be assessed without this, and it also indicates how material the interest is.

fields.label: Whether the business could conflict with policing duties, the Code of Ethics, or create a perception of conflict
fields.why_it_matters: This is the central question the grading turns on -- without it there is nothing to weigh.

fields.label: Whether the business could exploit the declarant's role, access, or force information
Financial structure (sole trader, director, partner, employee of the business, silent investor, etc.)
Any existing conditions or monitoring already in place (for a renewal/review case)
Line manager comments, if included in the source document

grading_factors.factor: Degree of conflict (or perceived conflict) with policing duties or the Code of Ethics
Potential for the business to exploit the declarant's role, information, or contacts
Working Time Regulations compliance (hours combined with police role)
Public confidence/reputational impact if the interest became publicly known
Whether conditions from a prior approval are being adhered to (renewal cases)

grading_notes: IOPC reporting flags non-adherence to conditions on approved interests, and continuation of declined interests, as recurring corruption risk areas -- weigh renewal/review cases against this specifically.

grading_definitions.Low: No material conflict identified; disclosure was proactive and complete; recommend approve, note for routine review.
grading_definitions.Medium: Some conflict or risk factor present but manageable with conditions; recommend approve with conditions and a defined review date.
grading_definitions.High: Significant conflict, proximity to criminality/corruption risk, or access/leverage concern; recommend escalation to a senior decision-maker or ADC-equivalent process rather than automatic approval.

letters._comment: Starter conditions and appeal boilerplate for the decision letter sent to the applicant. Editable -- these are generic placeholders, not force-specific policy.
standard_conditions: Do not use police systems, resources, or access in connection with this business
Do not conduct this business activity while on duty
Notify the Professional Standards Department immediately of any change in the nature, hours, or structure of this business
This approval must be reviewed immediately if there is any material change in circumstances
